scope: Independent static re-review of design02, design01 delta, unchanged pinned Node/Rust/SDK inputs, and new per-child temporary scope custody. No tests or implementation.

findings.problem: A fresh scope may be created successfully before SDK launch is skipped, fails, or rejects without returning BrowserServer. The only described scope-removal transition is gated by real SDK cleanup settlement plus actual browser child exit, so that known owned scope has no explicit cleanup path in this startup branch.
findings.required_revision: In the same existing finalize owner, await the retained original startup/resource-owner promise and define the no-returned-browser branch. Remove and independently check only a known freshly created scope under the same original total deadline. Never infer browser/descendant absence from a rejected launch or synthesize browser-cleanup success/ACK; keep unobserved browser custody UNKNOWN and preserve failure.
findings.late_resource_guard: Capture any successful mkdtemp result immediately in the original startup owner before elapsed-budget assertions or launch. Observation timeout must not replace/drop that owner. A later returned scope/browser stays owned by the same finalizer; hard-bound interruption stays unconfirmed with outer harness custody.

accepted_elements: Original total-budget monotonic checks after cleanup observations and around actual ACK completion now prevent overdue timer cancellation from becoming accepted late success.
Two-second close/kill observations and intentional cleanup-pending transition are described honestly under unchanged twelve-second total.

A single fresh mkdtemp scope and child-local TMPDIR override are a minimal ownership mechanism; no private SDK fields, provider substitution, global host environment mutation, or new cleanup engine is needed.

Actual scoped rm with propagated errors and a separate ENOENT-only lstat check can establish absence of this owned root at the gate, without claiming secure erasure, outside-scope destruction, or descendant absence.
All resource operations, scope removal, and ACK handling remain within the existing owner and original total budget.
Actual probe residual observations precede fallback intervention; provider promise settlement remains distinct from destruction and process-group absence.
implementation_guards: Only the exact mkdtemp-created path may be recursively removed; never the inherited caller TMPDIR or unrelated SDK/host paths.
Check the original startup budget before accepting scope/launch success; assign owned resources before a late-success check can throw.
Keep pending, fulfilled, and rejected/false SDK outcomes distinct; no fresh close/kill call may provide alternate completion.
Pair Node fixed diagnostic stages/fields with the strict private Rust schema and fresh exact source maps.
No-returned-browser cleanup failure or any original deadline expiry remains unconfirmed; ACK bytes alone cannot override Node failure status.
Outer harness custody remains required after Node hard exit, SIGKILL, or host failure.
limits: Design-only review; no new implementation source, compilation, test, filesystem cleanup, or process census was executed.
Historical exit3, FK-holder filesystem cause, P16, and precise removal delay remain UNPROVEN.
Scope absence is an observed root fact, not independent descendant absence or secure-erasure proof.
